topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it's really happening. I've known for a while, but I just couldn't bring myself to tell you. We've been so close for so long, and now all of a sudden, things are changing. I know I should have said something sooner, but the words just wouldn't come. I hate that you're finding out like this. I promise, I didn't keep it from you because I wanted to. It's just, once you're gone, it feels like a piece of my life is going to be missing. I don't know how to face that. I guess I was hoping if I didn't talk about it, maybe it wouldn't actually happen. I’m so sorry, and I hope you can understand.
